calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout Alignment
calls.summary: The team convened to address communication gaps and streamline feedback processes to enhance collaboration and reduce delays. Key decisions included centralizing feedback in designated platforms (Figma and Google Docs) to improve visibility, assigning specific roles for task management (Lucho for design, Tiffany for copy, and Sofia for tracking), and extending weekly meetings to one hour for thorough review sessions. The updated delivery plan introduced clearer timelines, with a calendar view for tracking progress, while content consistency was emphasized through linked copy and design templates. Stakeholder reviews are scheduled for mid-February to align priorities, and continuous improvement efforts will focus on transparency and tracking open items to foster collaboration and efficiency.
calls.keywords: Collaboration, Delivery Plan, Feedback Management, CMS Collections, Content Approval, Stakeholder Review
